scope: Convert the exact locally authored scratch DXF to AutoCAD 2004 DWG and compare the selected MLINE and MLINESTYLE using libdxfrw and GNU LibreDWG.

converter.transport: Official HTTPS download. The locally recorded hash binds the bytes used in this run.
converter.runtime: Docker Desktop 29.5.3 Linux on ARM64 with Ubuntu 24.04 x64 image under emulation, package extracted with dpkg-deb -x; Qt xcb and Xvfb; no container network, read-only source/package, no capabilities, unprivileged uid 65534, writable scratch output only.
converter.firstLaunch: Stopped before conversion because libOpenGL.so.0 was absent. Added Ubuntu's standard OpenGL runtime in the disposable image and retried the same source.

libraryRead.result: AC1018 import success, 165/165 observed source frames published, no entity or object parse failures. The current clean-package CLI separately agrees on the version and read disposition.

comparison.result: PASS. Both identify one MLINE 0x300 in model space, layer 0, linked to SCRATCH_MLINE 0xD under dictionary 0xA. Endpoints (0,0,0) and (20,0,0), directions, extrusion, miter, segment/fill arrays, scale and justification agree. The selected style has offsets +0.5 and -0.5, BYLAYER colors and linetype indexes, and 90-degree start/end angles. A separate producer-created Standard style exists. Binding is by the entity's actual style handle.

strictExport.result: Strict-complete preflight refused and no DXF was published. Read observations include HeaderSectionUnclaimedData (expected end 621, observed decoded section length 1360). The difference of 739 bytes is not a mapping for the AC1024 suffix.

limits: One scratch-authored source and one exact ODA converter release. This comparison binds typed reader results, not exact DWG bit spans or native rendering.

The initial placement screen interpreted the adapter model-space container's default *U0 name as an anonymous source block. Direct container identity and the peer model-space BLOCK_HEADER membership confirm correct placement.
No macOS ODA package was run or installed. The local macOS application signature/desktop problem remains separate.
